tbesh_html:
1) to lift up, cast up, exalt
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to cast up a highway
1a2) to cast up a way
1a3) to lift up (of song)
1b) (Pilpel) to exalt, esteem highly, prize
1c) (Hithpoel) to exalt oneself

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to mound up (especially a turnpike); figurative, to exalt; reflexively, to oppose (as by a dam)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: cast up, exalt (self), extol, make plain, raise up.
